Jenson Button drove for Renault in 2002, and his teammate was Jarno Trulli. Trulli appears as Renault's second driver in the 2002 race results I retrieved (European, San Marino, and United States Grands Prix), and Renault's 2002 constructor points (23) are consistent with a two-driver line-up. The search results don't list every race, so I haven't checked each round individually, but nothing I found suggests either driver changed during the year.

ANSWER: Jarno Trulli
